name: System updates bar button
description: Compact bar button showing pending system updates (pacman + AUR + flatpak + mise). Left-click opens a management card with per-source counts, individual re-scan and update buttons, scan-all, update-all, a show-when-up-to-date toggle (green check in the bar) and per-source scan toggles. Right-click forces a full re-check.
author: And0Null
permissions: Runs `checkupdates` every refreshMinutes (default 30) to count pending pacman repo updates
Runs `paru -Qua` (recommended; optional) or `yay -Qua`/`checkupdates-aur` to count pending AUR updates
Runs `flatpak remote-ls --updates` only when flatpak is installed
Runs `mise -C $HOME outdated` only when mise is installed (global config scope) to count outdated mise tools

Spawns a terminal via TerminalService.execDetached running per-source update commands (`sudo pacman -Syu`, `paru -Sua`, `flatpak update`, `mise upgrade`) or the full `paru -Syu` + `flatpak update` + `mise upgrade`
Adds a Top-layer management card per screen (keyboard focus only while the card is open)
Reads and writes its own mod settings (refreshMinutes, externalOnly, showWhenUpToDate, scanPacman, scanAur, scanFlatpak, scanMise)
